# Reverend Ez

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v3 c24 P3](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0003), [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** clergyman and minister  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c29 P6](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0006), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>
- **Titles:** Reverend  <sub>[v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>; Mr.  <sub>[v3 c26 P11](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0011), [v3 c29 P6](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0006)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Ez  <sub>[v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c38 P5](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0005), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)</sub>; Ezra Hale  <sub>[v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009)</sub>

## Appearance

He is described as extremely unattractive, possessing a large, gangly frame with elongated legs. He has flaxen, limp hair, green eyes, a large mouth, and an unkempt hair line concealing a scholarly forehead. However, he has a delightful voice and impassioned eyes when speaking.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P10](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0010), [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015)_

## Personality

He possesses a charming, gentle, and serious nature with a beautiful soul. He enjoys laughing, joking, and being playful, though he takes his ministerial duties with immense gravity, devotion, and faithfulness. He is accepting and affectionate toward his loved ones, understanding them beneath any superficial exterior.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P11](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0011), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c24 P19](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0019), [v3 c27 P21](../source/v03-c27.md#nw-v03-c27-p0021)_

## History

Ezra studied theology at St. Columbia after graduating from Wexcombe. During a summer break, he assumed responsibility for the Point Prospect Mission Church while boarding at Cousin Emily's rooming house. There he bonded with Cressida Lindsay through boating, fishing, and evening walks, as well as inspiring her through his powerful preaching. Though initially hesitant to ask for Cressy's hand in marriage due to his lack of wealth, the two became engaged. After overcoming the initial rage of Cressy's mother, Ezra visited Mount Holly where both of her parents grew fond of him. The couple married the following June. By the time of Nell and Hugh's September wedding, Ezra delivered what was praised as a most beautiful wedding prayer, and he and Cressy had welcomed infants into their family.

_Sources: [v3 c24 P9](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0009), [v3 c24 P12](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0012), [v3 c24 P15](../source/v03-c24.md#nw-v03-c24-p0015), [v3 c26 P11](../source/v03-c26.md#nw-v03-c26-p0011), [v3 c29 P6](../source/v03-c29.md#nw-v03-c29-p0006), [v3 c35 P10](../source/v03-c35.md#nw-v03-c35-p0010), [v3 c38 P5](../source/v03-c38.md#nw-v03-c38-p0005), [v4 c3 P44](../source/v04-c03.md#nw-v04-c03-p0044), [v4 c4 P16](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0016)_
